fields.Name: C1 -> S2.3
fields.Description: Gate G1.6 (phase 1, dataset C1, criterion S2.3): after a model is trained on version 1 of the C1 renewal unit, editing the label window creates version 2 with LabelVersion 2 in the same lineage, the model's lineage still references version 1, and saving the edit over version 1 in place is refused. It fails when the label-definition comparison reports no change, so the label edit creates no version 2.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Version 2 with LabelVersion 2 created; the model references unit version 1; the in-place edit is refused.
